scope: P5U no-data design; P5V single-machine CPU-warm baseline-only profiling specified but not executed

research_positioning.claim: safe, selective reordering only when an input-pipeline bottleneck is demonstrated

research_questions.question: When is reordering worth studying?
research_questions.hypothesis: At least one registered cell meets both qualification thresholds.

research_questions.question: Can strict semantic authorization safely reduce candidates?
research_questions.hypothesis: No confirmed semantic counterexample is authorized.

research_questions.question: Can D improve end-to-end behavior without task harm?
research_questions.hypothesis: D/A meets the registered paired performance gate in a qualified target; C/A is descriptive only.

research_questions.question: Does the cost gate avoid safe-but-not-worthwhile choices?
research_questions.hypothesis: D/C is a registered secondary comparison and the cost gate does not worsen stability.

split_contract.profile_calibration_split: P5V baseline profiling and target/contrast selection only
split_contract.p5v_model_parameters: discard; never initialize P5W or task evaluation
split_contract.forced_image_reuse: freeze reuse boundary before execution and downgrade result to non-blind descriptive evidence

p5v_measurement.purpose: baseline forward/backward/optimizer steps for end-to-end time decomposition only; no multi-arm benefit experiment or complete training/convergence evaluation
p5v_measurement.invalid_action: first-error stop; no automatic rerun, no post-hoc outlier deletion, no block substitution

definitions.predicted_gain_time: only measured serialized costs exposed on the critical path; not an observed speedup
definitions.timing_boundary: end_to_end_step_time starts at block batch acquisition and ends after optimizer step; consumer_blocked_wait_time is exposed consumer wait

qualification.contrast: cell with minimum predicted_gain_share among all four cells; if qualified, call low-opportunity contrast
qualification.no_qualification_action: stop reorder experiments and retain descriptive baseline only

arms.B: cost/heuristic reorder without AutoContract authorization; risk contrast only
arms.D: AutoContract strict-safe candidates plus cost model and 5% selection gate

cost_model.break_even_batches: ceil(fixed_overhead/per_batch_saving) when per_batch_saving > 0; nonexistent when per_batch_saving <= 0
cost_model.one_time_overhead_recording: P5W records receipt verification, cost selection, and Cedar planning separately; none is mixed into steady-state primary wall-time
cost_model.expansion_factor: explains shape/bytes only; not safety evidence

safety_layers.scope: Normalize↔RandomCrop(no padding), single-machine high-resolution vision input; other candidates are not automatically included
safety_layers.unknown_policy: Unknown or unproven candidates are rejected
task_result_complement: 3 fixed-seed paired trainings on legal labeled validation data
safety_layers.task_result_role: secondary sanity check; 3 seeds do not prove statistical equivalence or general non-inferiority
safety_layers.relationship: strict semantic layer is necessary; any failure blocks task training and benefit statistics; task-result layer is complementary; neither substitutes for the other

future_statistics_and_stopping.p5v: 5 warm-up + 20 measured blocks per cell; report median/IQR/MAD; invalid on MAD/median > 10% or environment/power/temperature gate failure
future_statistics_and_stopping.future: target and contrast each 20 paired blocks; pre-generated balanced order; primary=D/A paired end-to-end wall-time ratio; fixed-seed 10000-draw percentile bootstrap on log ratio; benefit requires D/A median < 0.95 and 95% CI upper < 0.95; C/A descriptive ablation; D/C secondary
future_statistics_and_stopping.task_non_inferiority_margin: not yet determined; blocker before P5W freeze and cannot replace performance gate

blockers: labeled dataset and four mutually exclusive split contracts must be resolved before P5V
explicit authorization must be obtained before P5V
task-level non-inferiority margin must be fixed before P5W freeze
